data.narrative:
Skild AI is a Series C artificial intelligence and software company founded by Deepak Pathak and Abhinav Gupta, currently valued at $14.0B post-money following $1.4B+ in total capital raised. The valuation assessment draws from a comparable universe of seven same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers supplemented by one public comparable (Palantir, PLTR), including Figure AI ($39.0B Series C), Scale AI ($29.0B Series B), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B Series C), Wayve ($8.6B Series D), and Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C-to-next-stage step-ups, yielding $23.8B implied value. Peer-median methodology calculates the median across the seven-company comparable set at $8.6B, with a reported range spanning $2.0B to $39.0B. The peer cohort exhibits substantial dispersion reflecting stage and business model variation within the frontier AI sector.

Triangulation of these two methods produces a range of $7.3B (low) to $27.4B (high), with a median of $16.2B. The current $14.0B valuation sits within the lower-middle portion of this range, slightly below the triangulated median. Key uncertainties include the appropriate multiplier assumption for this company's specific stage transition and the heterogeneity of business models and maturity within the peer set, which spans from Series B through Series D funding.
